title: UrduSpeech: A 156-Hour Urdu Speech Corpus with 12-Dimension Paralinguistic Annotations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating automatic speech recognition (ASR) performance disparities by comparing Word Error Rate (WER) and Character Error Rate (CER) of various transcription models (Whisper-Large-v3, OmniASR-LLM-1B, and Gemini-2.5-Pro) on speech segments with and without Urdu-English code-switching.

Qualitative evaluation of model failure modes, specifically analyzing how certain models exhibit hallucinations and word-looping when processing Pakistani-accented English and code-switched audio segments.
